items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: Oh, yeah? No, I don't know him.

ctx.x: You ever know Papa D. Dot Dot? No, I don't think.

I don't think I know. He was one of Steve's buddies. He was always getting in trouble, you know, and Steve would get him out of jail. Oh, yeah? No, I don't know him. Uh, what would these songs be about that Steve Lewis would sing?

Anything come in his mind. Yeah, anything come in his mind, he'd say it. Yeah, he didn't care what he said, the way he said it, anything come in his mind, he'd say stuff I know he was playing there on the Island Charter. Man you couldn't get in the place. From the time he get there and the time he leave. He get there around. He do that eight. He get there around ten, eleven. Anytime. But the people still be there waiting for him when he come in.
